notes.title: First Update!
notes.notes:
It's time for the game's first update!


 The game was a little too easy, so the jar is now a little narrower and the desserts are slightly bigger. Good luck!
 The guideline is no longer an ugly green but a faint white. A cute little chalk board has been added to the table with a legend on it for you to know where you are up to.
 Some other small bug and code fixes.


Have fun and stay tuned for the next update!
